title: Hearing on Probation Department's organizational strategy and youth rights bill
summary: The Council's Committee on Criminal Justice held an oversight hearing on the Department of Probation's organizational strategy, covering staffing shortages, program changes, and shifts in approach under new Commissioner Sharun Goodwin after former Commissioner Juanita Holmes. The Department has roughly 977 staff with a 23% vacancy rate and supervises about 11,833 people, including 1,152 young people. The committee also heard Introduction 1104, sponsored by Chair Brooks-Powers, which would require the Department to give youth accused of crimes notices explaining the criminal legal process.
